item.title: Marine forecast — 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
item.description:
NWS Forecast for: 21NM SSE Wiscasset ME
Atlantic Ocean
Issued by: National Weather Service Gray/Portland, ME
Last Update: 12:05 am EDT Sep 3, 2026

Thursday: SE wind around 10 kt. Rain and possibly a thunderstorm before noon, then a chance of showers, mainly between noon and 5pm. Patchy fog before 10am. Seas 2 ft building to 4 ft.

Thursday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Areas of fog after 2am. Seas 3 to 4 ft.

Friday: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Areas of fog before 8am. Seas around 3 ft.

Friday Night: WNW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming N after midnight. Partly cloudy. Seas around 3 ft.

Saturday: NNE wind around 10 kt. Mostly sunny. Seas around 3 ft.

Saturday Night: N wind 10 to 15 kt. Partly cloudy. Seas around 2 ft.

Sunday: N wind 10 to 15 kt decreasing to 5 to 10 kt in the afternoon. Winds could gust as high as 20 kt. Mostly sunny. Seas 2 to 3 ft.

Sunday Night: Variable winds 5 kt or less. Partly cloudy. Seas 1 to 2 ft.

Labor Day: NNW wind 5 to 10 kt becoming SSW in the afternoon. Sunny. Seas around 1 ft.
